answer.reason: The verses tell of Micah's household shrine and his hired Levite priest, and of the Danites taking both away.

clauses.english: made a house of gods with an ephod and teraphim, and consecrated his son as priest
clauses.quote: the man Micah had an house of gods, and made an ephod, and teraphim

clauses.english: hired a Levite from Bethlehemjudah to be his priest
clauses.quote: Dwell with me, and be unto me a father and a priest

clauses.english: lost his images and his priest to the men of Dan, who were too strong for him
clauses.quote: when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back unto his house

doubts: JDG 17:4 says Micah's mother had the graven image made; the clause on his house of gods rests on JDG 17:5, so the citation may be narrowed to that verse.
The verses given do not say how Micah's son priest was replaced; only that he later had the Levite as priest.
